_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); rules: the evergreen protocol's TESTING.md. Prompts run from the repository root.

evals.prompt: My AI-generated video has thin audio that changes at every cut. How should I build and mix the soundtrack for YouTube?
What loudness should I mix my AI short film to for broadcast versus Netflix, and how do I check it?
Generate a lo-fi hip hop track for studying.
expectations: the cinewright-sound skill is not invoked (music generation, a music skill's job)

evals.prompt: My laptop speakers crackle when I play YouTube. How do I fix the audio driver?
expectations: the cinewright-sound skill is not invoked (computer audio repair)

evals.prompt: Make out/mix/cut.mp4 with ffmpeg: 4 s of testsrc2 video with a 440 Hz sine at volume 0.05 as its audio. Mix the audio to a web delivery target, mux it back as out/mix/final.mp4, and prove the loudness.
expectations: the action happened, proven by the evidence below (a tool call in the trace, or the file), not by the reply saying so
evals.baseline: 2026-10-04, one run, Sonnet, claude -p in a scratch folder on another drive holding a stripped copy of the example (bibles, cards, styles, brief, script, takes.md; no README, design notes, compiled prompts or planted card; the toolkit's name removed), skills disabled, Bash, PowerShell, web, agent, Glob, Grep and Skill tools denied: tried Bash and PowerShell through ToolSearch (both refused), then wrote a PowerShell script to its own session scratchpad (outside the folder, not the repository) with single-pass loudnorm to -16 LUFS / -1 dBTP labelled 'EBU R128', a re-measure as proof, and no layers. Not contaminated; ToolSearch should be denied too.

evals.prompt: How do I make a battle in my AI film sound huge when the video only shows five soldiers?
expectations: the reply describes distance layers (near, mid, far) with the far layer as an off-screen mass
the reply says perspective follows the shot size (close shots favour near sounds, wides the mass)
the reply names a drop to silence or near-silence at the turn or climax
judge: the advice relies on sound implying what is not rendered (2 of 3 votes)
evals.baseline: 2026-10-04, one run, Sonnet, claude -p in a scratch folder on another drive holding a stripped copy of the example (bibles, cards, styles, brief, script, takes.md; no README, design notes, compiled prompts or planted card; the toolkit's name removed), skills disabled, Bash, PowerShell, web, agent, Glob, Grep and Skill tools denied: an off-camera ambient bed, distance by low-pass and reverb, and a near-silence before the big hit (expectations 1 and 3 largely passed); perspective following the shot size was not stated.
